items.title: 67460_Sammy Price oral history interview
items.q: So I bought this club with Felix Valdez

ctx.x: The Jazz Festival Society of Philadelphia was...a guy named Al Rose had the idea to have some sessions and they approached me. Miss Bowman and a lawyer and Al approached me. They said, 'Well, we're interested in the thing. But we can't be interested in the thing to underwrite...' because I felt like in order for it to be a success you'd have to have these sessions every week. So we got together and organized the Jazz Festivals Society of Philadelphia, Sammy Price Director, Jane Bowman, who worked for... ....NWAS,…

And then...I had bought a club with a couple of guys, an after hours spot. Well, it was a club, you know, drinking and that business. In Philadelphia on Sunday you couldn't buy whiskey. But we had...this is when we had our sessions. So I bought this club with Felix Valdez and some more people and we used to have Jazz Festival Society concerts in the

club. Then I decided, well, what the hell. I went to Ike Levy and asked him to call the Academy of Music and see if they'd let me have the foyer. And a man by the name of Mason who was the manager of the Academy...naturally, Ike Levy called him and he said yes. So then I started having the concerts in the foyer, the foyer of the Academy of Music.
